comment: Passkeys (ADR-0066, ADR-0069): the WebAuthn RP-ID is the apex circletools.ch (Auth:Passkey:ServerDomain), so Android Credential Manager fetches THIS file to authorize the app's passkeys. get_login_creds is the relation passkeys require; the Secret-Santa Android app authenticates against this RP. The fingerprints are Play's APP SIGNING keys (Play Console > App integrity > App signing). The app signing key was ROTATED, so BOTH the current and previous app-signing certificates must be listed — Credential Manager/FIDO validates the original (pre-rotation) key for a rotated app, so listing only the current key is not enough (that was the 2026-10-06 bug: get_login_creds returned 'RP ID cannot be validated' even though the current key was present and Google's assetlinks:check reported it linked). First entry (FD:D7…): CURRENT app signing key. Second entry (BB:EF…): PREVIOUS app signing key (rotated away from). Both read from Play Console on 2026-10-06. Add more apps' packages here as they ship.
